generations.name: First generation (PPE)
generations.notes: PPE, 800 V, 113 kWh gross / 108 kWh usable, up to 400 kW DC, 11 kW AC (inductive charging optional). Coupe is a body variant; "Range Setup" and 21" tire ratings are options. Confidence: medium-high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Porsche_Cayenne
